## Problem and scope

Describe the current behavior, the intended invariant, and why a change is needed.

## Audit and plan

- [ ] Independently reviewed affected source and relevant contracts
- [ ] Defined objective/acceptance criteria before implementing
- [ ] Avoided duplicated helpers, dead paths and avoidable latency

## Security and performance

Describe plaintext/file/SQLite/UI/key lifetime impact and concurrency, failure and performance risks. State "none" only after review.

## Verification (paste commands and outcomes)

- [ ] Formatting and source contract checks
- [ ] Relevant browser and Rust tests
- [ ] Targeted adversarial and negative tests for changed behavior
- [ ] Mac native behavior checked (or explicitly documented as not run)
- [ ] Independent post-change re-audit confirms objectives

## Documentation / release implications

List the documents updated and any remaining blocker; do not claim release-ready on static validation alone.
